description: This file implements Netlink socket communication, including serialization/deserialization of Netlink messages, sending and receiving data over sockets, and managing message sequences and pending messages within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles Netlink message serialization/deserialization and maintains a sequence ID for messages.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication, including sending, receiving, and handling pending Netlink messages.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into Netlink message components.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message over the socket, with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response, exchanging Netlink messages.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket, returning the size of the data.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data from the socket, updating pending messages accordingly.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket (empty implementation).
